# Tool windows

All `toolWindow` registrations in IntelliJ Community 2026.2 that ship with IntelliJ IDEA. Anchor/secondary define the default stripe position (secondary = lower/right-hand part of the stripe in the New UI). Shortcuts are the defaults of the matching `Activate…ToolWindow` action.

| Id | Anchor | Secondary | Windows | macOS | Module |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Problems View | bottom | no | Alt+6 | Cmd+6 | `platform/platform-resources` |
| Statistics Event Log | bottom | no |  |  | `platform/statistics/devkit` |
| Terminal | bottom | no | Alt+F12 | Alt+F12 | `plugins/terminal` |
| TODO | bottom | no |  |  | `platform/todo` |
| Version Control | bottom | no | Alt+9 | Cmd+9 | `platform/vcs-impl` |
| Backup and Sync History | left | no |  |  | `platform/settings-sync-core` |
| Commit | left | no | Alt+0 | Cmd+0 | `platform/vcs-impl` |
| Learn | left | no |  |  | `plugins/ide-features-trainer/res/META-INF/plugin.xml` |
| Merge Requests | left | no |  |  | `plugins/gitlab/gitlab-core` |
| Project | left | no | Alt+1 | Cmd+1 | `platform/platform-resources` |
| Pull Requests | left | no |  |  | `plugins/github/github-core` |
| Bookmarks | left | yes | Alt+2 | Cmd+2 | `platform/bookmarks` |
| Structure | left | yes | Alt+7 | Cmd+7 | `platform/structure-view-impl` |
| Ant | right | no |  |  | `plugins/ant` |
| Commander | right | no |  |  | `plugins/commander` |
| Gradle | right | no |  |  | `plugins/gradle/plugin-resources/intellij.gradle.xml` |
| UI Theme Color Picker | right | no |  |  | `platform/platform-resources` |
| Coverage | right | yes |  |  | `plugins/coverage-common` |
| Notifications | right | yes |  |  | `platform/platform-resources` |

## Tool windows registered at runtime

These have an `Activate…ToolWindow` action with a default shortcut but are created programmatically (Run, Debug, Find, Services, Build, Maven, ...), so their stripe position comes from the UI documentation ([ui/workbench.md](ui/workbench.md)).

| Tool window | Action | Windows | macOS |
|---|---|---|---|
| Debug | `ActivateDebugToolWindow` | Alt+5 | Cmd+5 |
| Find | `ActivateFindToolWindow` | Alt+3 | Cmd+3 |
| Nu Get (tool window) | `ActivateNuGetToolWindow` | Alt+Shift+7 | Cmd+Alt+7 |
| Run | `ActivateRunToolWindow` | Alt+4 | Cmd+4 |
| Services (tool window) | `ActivateServicesToolWindow` | Alt+8 | Cmd+8 |
| Unit Tests (tool window) | `ActivateUnitTestsToolWindow` | Alt+Shift+8 | Cmd+Alt+8 |
